    el("path",{d:d,fill:"none",stroke:s.color,"stroke-width":s.width||2.5,"stroke-dasharray":s.dash||""},svg);
    (s.dots||[]).forEach(function(p){var g=el("g",{},svg);el("circle",{"class":"hit",cx:xf(p.x),cy:yf(p.y),r:11},g);el("circle",{cx:xf(p.x),cy:yf(p.y),r:p.r||5,fill:s.color,stroke:"#fff","stroke-width":1.5},g);bindMark(g,p.tip);});});
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- headline forest ---------- */
function frow(src,spec,fold){return src[spec];}
function headline(){
  var spec=$("input[name=fspec]:checked").value;var folds=$$("input[name=ffold]:checked").map(function(i){return i.value;});
  var rows=[];var specs=spec==="both"?["coprimary","primary"]:[spec];
  var SRC={screen:FS,heldout:FH,mesh:FM};
  var nA=0,nAsig=0,nCTsig=0,nCT=0,notes=[];
  ["screen","heldout","mesh"].forEach(function(fd){if(folds.indexOf(fd)<0)return;specs.forEach(function(sp){var r=SRC[fd][sp];if(!r)return;
    var col=fd==="mesh"?"var(--green)":"var(--accent)";var spn=sp==="coprimary"?"co-primary":"primary";
    var lab=FOLDNAME[fd]+" · "+spn;
    rows.push({label:lab,bold:true,est:r.A.irr,lo:r.A.lo,hi:r.A.hi,color:col,hollow:sp==="primary",value:f(r.A.irr)+" ["+f(r.A.lo)+", "+f(r.A.hi)+"] p "+fp(r.A.p),
      tip:"<b>"+FOLDNAME[fd]+", "+spn+" specification</b><br>Host-vocabulary share: IRR per SD "+f(r.A.irr)+", 95% CI "+f(r.A.lo)+" to "+f(r.A.hi)+", p "+fp(r.A.p)+"<br>N = "+comma(r.N)+" events, G = "+r.G+" concept clusters"});
    rows.push({label:"co-transfer",est:r.CT.irr,lo:r.CT.lo,hi:r.CT.hi,color:"var(--base)",small:true,value:f(r.CT.irr)+" ["+f(r.CT.lo)+", "+f(r.CT.hi)+"] p "+fp(r.CT.p),
      tip:"<b>"+FOLDNAME[fd]+", "+spn+": co-transfer</b><br>IRR per SD "+f(r.CT.irr)+", 95% CI "+f(r.CT.lo)+" to "+f(r.CT.hi)+", p "+fp(r.CT.p)});
    nA++;if(r.A.lo>1)nAsig++;else notes.push(FOLDNAME[fd]+" "+spn+" ("+f(r.A.irr)+", "+r.G+" clusters)");nCT++;if(r.CT.lo>1||r.CT.hi<1)nCTsig++;});});
  if(folds.indexOf("ivw")>=0&&spec!=="primary")rows.push({label:"IVW pooled · co-primary",bold:true,est:FI.irr,lo:FI.lo,hi:FI.hi,color:"var(--amber)",diamond:true,value:f(FI.irr)+" ["+f(FI.lo)+", "+f(FI.hi)+"] I² "+f(FI.I2,0),
    tip:"<b>Inverse-variance weighted pool of the three co-primary estimates</b><br>IRR per SD "+f(FI.irr)+", 95% CI "+f(FI.lo)+" to "+f(FI.hi)+", I² = "+f(FI.I2,0)});
  var box=$("#c-forest");
  if(!rows.length){box.innerHTML='<p class="note">Select at least one fold.</p>';$("#t-forest").textContent="Nothing is selected.";return;}
  forest(box,{rows:rows,log:true,xmin:0.55,xmax:2.0,ticks:[0.6,0.8,1,1.25,1.5,2],nullAt:1,xlabel:"IRR per SD of host-vocabulary share (log scale)",tickFmt:function(t){return t===1?"1":String(t);}});
  var t;
  if(nA===0)t="Only the pooled estimate is shown: "+f(FI.irr)+" ["+f(FI.lo)+", "+f(FI.hi)+"].";
  else{t=nAsig+" of "+nA+" host-vocabulary estimates shown have intervals entirely above 1";
    t+=notes.length?"; the exception is "+notes.join(" and ")+", whose interval spans 1.":".";
    t+=" Co-transfer, the competing channel, "+(nCTsig===0?"has an interval covering 1 in every row shown.":"excludes 1 in "+nCTsig+" of "+nCT+" rows.");}
  $("#t-forest").textContent=t;
}
function bigNumber(){var r=FM.coprimary.A;$("#big-num").textContent="+"+Math.round((r.irr-1)*100)+"%";
  $("#big-cap").textContent="MeSH co-primary incidence-rate ratio "+f(r.irr)+" per SD (95% CI "+f(r.lo)+" to "+f(r.hi)+", p "+fp(r.p)+"; "+comma(FM.coprimary.N)+" events in "+FM.coprimary.G+" concepts). Pre-registered verdict: REPLICATED.";}

/* ---------- stepper ---------- */
var S=STEP;var stages=[
 {k:"Concept pool",short:"1 Pool"},{k:"Host entry",short:"2 Entry"},{k:"Partner vocabulary",short:"3 Share"},{k:"Newcomer outcome",short:"4 Outcome"},{k:"Model",short:"5 Model"}];
var cur=0;
function drawPipe(){var box=$("#c-pipe");var o=newSvg(box,74),svg=o.svg,W=o.W;var n=stages.length,gap=10,w=(W-gap*(n-1))/n;
  stages.forEach(function(s,i){var x=i*(w+gap);var on=i===cur,done=i<cur;
    el("rect",{x:x,y:8,width:w,height:48,rx:8,fill:on?"#0b5fa5":done?"#e6f0f9":"#fff",stroke:on?"#0b5fa5":"#c9ced4","stroke-width":1.5},svg);
    var lab=w<110?s.short:s.k;var t=el("text",{x:x+w/2,y:37,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":w<80?11:13,"font-weight":on?700:500,fill:on?"#fff":"#1c232b"},svg,lab);
    if(t.getBBox().width>w-6)t.textContent=String(i+1);
    if(i<n-1)el("path",{d:"M"+(x+w+1)+" 32 l"+(gap-3)+" 0",stroke:"#8a939c","stroke-width":2},svg);});}
function kv(pairs){return '<dl class="kv">'+pairs.map(function(p){return "<dt>"+p[0]+"</dt><dd>"+p[1]+"</dd>";}).join("")+"</dl>";}
function renderStage(){
  var box=$("#c-step");box.innerHTML="";var yrs=Object.keys(S.counts).map(Number).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
  var inH,doH,outH,why,chart;
  if(cur===0){inH="A noun phrase mined from arXiv titles and abstracts: <strong>"+esc(S.phrase)+"</strong>.";
    doH="Keep concepts first used "+"2005 to 2016 with 20 to 300 papers in the first-appearance window and at most 8,000 works to 2024. The frame is frozen and hashed before any later data are read, then split into Screen and Held-out folds by a hash of the concept identifier.";
    outH=kv([["First year (F)",S.F],["Origin subfield",esc(S.origin)],["Fold","Screen"],["Diffusion type",S.type==="BROAD"?"broad from the start":"localised"]]);
    why="Choosing concepts before seeing their future keeps the pool outcome-blind: nothing about later success decides who is in it.";
    chart=function(){bars(box,{height:220,items:yrs.map(function(y){return {label:String(y),short:String(y).slice(2),value:S.counts[y],color:y<S.F?"#c3c8ce":"var(--accent)",tip:"<b>"+y+"</b>: "+S.counts[y]+" OpenAlex works"};}),ymax:40,step:10,yfmt:function(t){return String(t);},ylabel:"Works per year",xlabel:"Year (OpenAlex works mentioning the concept)"});};}
  else if(cur===1){inH="All verified works carrying the concept, each with its OpenAlex primary subfield.";
    doH="Find the first year the concept appears in a subfield other than its origin, together with at least five co-occurring partner terms. That (concept, host, year) triple is one host-entry event.";
    outH=kv([["Host subfield",esc(S.host)],["Entry year (e)",S.e],["Entry papers",S.n_entry_papers],["Distinct partner terms",S.n_partners]]);
    why="The entry event is the unit of analysis: the same concept enters many hosts, and the design compares entries of one concept with each other.";chart=null;}
  else if(cur===2){inH="The "+S.n_partners+" partner terms that co-occur with the concept in its entry papers, and each partner's pre-entry publication profile by subfield.";
    doH="Host-vocabulary share: the tag-weighted mean of each partner's pre-entry publication share in the host subfield. Co-transfer: the fraction of partners that were origin companions of the concept in the five years before entry.";
    var rank=EV.screen.filter(function(e){return e.share<S.share;}).length/EV.screen.length;
    outH=kv([["Host-vocabulary share",f(S.share,3)],["Co-transfer",f(S.ct,1)],["Higher than","<span>"+pct(rank)+" of Screen entries</span>"]]);
    why="A share of "+f(S.share,3)+" is high: the Screen co-primary sample has mean 0.043 (SD 0.055). Here the concept arrived with vocabulary the host already used, not as a package of origin terms.";
    chart=function(){var bins=[];var bw=0.02;for(var i=0;i<12;i++)bins.push(0);EV.screen.forEach(function(e){var b=Math.min(11,Math.floor(e.share/bw));bins[b]++;});
      var sb=Math.min(11,Math.floor(S.share/bw));
      bars(box,{height:230,items:bins.map(function(c,i){var lo=i*bw,hi=(i+1)*bw;return {label:f(lo,2),short:f(lo,2).slice(1),value:c,color:i===sb?"var(--amber)":"#9fb8cf",tip:"Host-vocabulary share "+f(lo,2)+" to "+(i===11?"max":f(hi,2))+": "+c+" Screen entries"+(i===sb?"<br><b>The example entry ("+f(S.share,3)+") falls here</b>":"")};}),ymax:1000,step:250,yfmt:function(t){return comma(t);},ylabel:"Screen entries",xlabel:"Host-vocabulary share, bin start (orange: this entry)"});};}
  else if(cur===3){inH="Every host-subfield paper carrying the concept in the five years after entry ("+(S.e+1)+" to "+(S.e+5)+").";
    doH="Count only papers by author-disjoint newcomers: authors with no prior concept paper and no co-authorship with concept authors. Separately flag binary establishment (at least five newcomer papers in at least three of five years).";
    outH=kv([["Newcomer papers",S.newcomers],["All host papers",S.Y_all],["Took root",S.rooted?"yes":"no"]]);
    why="Counting newcomers, not the concept's own authors, asks whether the host field itself picked the idea up.";chart=null;}
  else{inH="All "+comma(FS.coprimary.N)+" Screen co-primary events: share, co-transfer, controls and the newcomer counts.";
    doH="Poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood regression with concept, entry-year and host fixed effects and concept-clustered standard errors. For a predictive check, a controls-only model and the same model plus host share and co-transfer are refitted leaving out whole concepts.";
    outH=kv([["IRR per SD (Screen)",f(FS.coprimary.A.irr)],["Controls-only prediction",f(S.pred_base,1)],["With host share",f(S.pred_method,1)],["Observed",S.newcomers]]);
    why="Adding the host-vocabulary share moves this entry's out-of-fold prediction from "+f(S.pred_base,1)+" to "+f(S.pred_method,1)+" newcomer papers, towards the "+S.newcomers+" observed. The inferential test is the fixed-effects coefficient, not this single prediction.";
    chart=function(){bars(box,{height:220,items:[{label:"Controls only",value:S.pred_base,color:"var(--base)",tip:"Out-of-fold prediction, controls-only Poisson model: "+f(S.pred_base,2)},{label:"+ host share, co-transfer",short:"+ share",value:S.pred_method,color:"var(--accent)",tip:"Out-of-fold prediction with host-vocabulary share and co-transfer added: "+f(S.pred_method,2)},{label:"Observed",value:S.newcomers,color:"var(--green)",tip:"Observed newcomer papers, "+(S.e+1)+" to "+(S.e+5)+": "+S.newcomers}],ymax:40,step:10,yfmt:String,valfmt:function(v){return f(v,1);},ylabel:"Newcomer papers"});};}
  $("#st-title").textContent="Stage "+(cur+1)+" of "+stages.length+": "+stages[cur].k;
  $("#st-in").innerHTML=inH;$("#st-do").innerHTML=doH;$("#st-out").innerHTML=outH;$("#st-why").textContent=why;
  if(chart)chart();
  $$("#st-marks button").forEach(function(b,i){if(i===cur)b.setAttribute("aria-current","step");else b.removeAttribute("aria-current");});
  $("#st-prev").disabled=cur===0;$("#st-next").disabled=cur===stages.length-1;
  $("#st-live").textContent="Stage "+(cur+1)+" of "+stages.length+": "+stages[cur].k;
  drawPipe();
}
function initStepper(){var ol=$("#st-marks");stages.forEach(function(s,i){var li=document.createElement("li");var b=document.createElement("button");b.type="button";b.textContent=String(i+1);b.setAttribute("aria-label","Stage "+(i+1)+": "+s.k);b.addEventListener("click",function(){cur=i;renderStage();});li.appendChild(b);ol.appendChild(li);});
  $("#st-prev").addEventListener("click",function(){if(cur>0){cur--;renderStage();}});
  $("#st-next").addEventListener("click",function(){if(cur<stages.length-1){cur++;renderStage();}});
  $("#stepper").addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.target.matches("input,select"))return;if(e.key==="ArrowRight"&&cur<stages.length-1){cur++;renderStage();e.preventDefault();}else if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"&&cur>0){cur--;renderStage();e.preventDefault();}});
  renderStage();}

/* ---------- gradient ---------- */
function gradient(){
  var fd=$("input[name=gfold]:checked").value,m=$("#gmetric").value;var sel=$("#gmetric");
  sel.querySelector("option[value=rooted]").disabled=(fd==="heldout");if(fd==="heldout"&&m==="rooted"){sel.value="any";m="any";}
  var E=EV[fd];var qs=[0,1,2,3,4].map(function(q){return E.filter(function(e){return e.q===q;});});
  var val=function(a){if(m==="any")return a.filter(function(e){return e.newcomers>=1;}).length/a.length;if(m==="mean")return a.reduce(function(s,e){return s+e.newcomers;},0)/a.length;return a.filter(function(e){return e.rooted===1;}).length/a.length;};
  var all=val(E);var vals=qs.map(val);var mx=Math.max.apply(null,vals.concat([all]));
  var isRate=m!=="mean";var step=isRate?(mx>0.5?0.2:0.1):(mx>20?10:mx>10?5:2);var ymax=Math.ceil(mx*1.12/step)*step;
  var fmtv=isRate?function(v){return pct(v);}:function(v){return f(v,1);};
  var items=qs.map(function(a,i){var lo=a[0].share,hi=a[a.length-1].share;return {label:"Q"+(i+1)+" "+f(lo,3)+"–"+f(hi,3),short:"Q"+(i+1),value:vals[i],color:"var(--accent)",tip:"<b>Quintile "+(i+1)+"</b> of host-vocabulary share ("+f(lo,3)+" to "+f(hi,3)+")<br>"+comma(a.length)+" entries<br>"+$("#gmetric").selectedOptions[0].text+": "+fmtv(vals[i])};});
  bars($("#c-grad"),{items:items,ymax:ymax,step:step,yfmt:isRate?function(t){return pct(t);}:function(t){return f(t,0);},valfmt:fmtv,ylabel:isRate?"Share of entries":"Mean newcomer papers",xlabel:"Quintile of host-vocabulary share (Q1 lowest)",ref:{value:all}});
  $("#grad-note").textContent="the dashed line is the "+FOLDNAME[fd]+" average across all "+comma(E.length)+" entries ("+fmtv(all)+").";
  var ratio=vals[4]/Math.max(vals[0],1e-9);
  $("#t-grad").textContent="In the "+FOLDNAME[fd]+" records, entries in the top fifth of host-vocabulary share reach "+fmtv(vals[4])+" against "+fmtv(vals[0])+" in the bottom fifth"+(vals[0]>0?" ("+f(ratio,1)+" times)":"")+". "+(vals[4]>vals[0]?"The raw gradient points the same way as the regression.":"The raw gradient does not point the way the regression does.");
}

/* ---------- browser ---------- */
var bShown=60,bSel=null;
function bList(){var fd=$("#bfold").value,fl=$("#bfilter").value,so=$("#bsort").value,q=$("#bsearch").value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var fopt=$("#bfilter").querySelector("option[value=rooted]");fopt.disabled=fd==="heldout";if(fd==="heldout"&&fl==="rooted"){$("#bfilter").value="all";fl="all";}
  var E=EV[fd].filter(function(e){if(fl==="any"&&e.newcomers<1)return false;if(fl==="none"&&e.newcomers>0)return false;if(fl==="rooted"&&e.rooted!==1)return false;if(fl==="hi0"&&!(e.q===4&&e.newcomers===0))return false;if(fl==="lo1"&&!(e.q===0&&e.newcomers>=5))return false;
    if(q&&e.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0&&e.hostName.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0)return false;return true;});
  var key={share:function(a,b){return b.share-a.share;},y:function(a,b){return b.newcomers-a.newcomers||b.share-a.share;},gain:function(a,b){return Math.abs(b.pred_method-b.pred_base)-Math.abs(a.pred_method-a.pred_base);},year:function(a,b){return a.year-b.year||b.share-a.share;}}[so];
  E.sort(key);return E;}
function bRender(keepSel){var E=bList();var fd=$("#bfold").value;var ul=$("#bul");ul.innerHTML="";
  if(!keepSel||E.indexOf(bSel)<0)bSel=E[0]||null;
  E.slice(0,bShown).forEach(function(e){var li=document.createElement("li");var b=document.createElement("button");b.type="button";b.className="item";b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",e===bSel?"true":"false");
    b.innerHTML="<strong>"+esc(e.name)+"</strong>"+(e.rooted===1?'<span class="pill g">rooted</span>':"")+'<span class="meta">'+esc(e.hostName)+" · "+e.year+" · share "+f(e.share,3)+" · "+e.newcomers+" newcomer papers</span>";
    b.addEventListener("click",function(){bSel=e;$$("#bul button.item").forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");});b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","true");bDetail();});li.appendChild(b);ul.appendChild(li);});
  $("#bmore").hidden=E.length<=bShown;
  var fl=$("#bfilter").selectedOptions[0].text;
  $("#bcount").textContent=comma(E.length)+" of "+comma(EV[fd].length)+" "+FOLDNAME[fd]+" entries match ("+fl.toLowerCase()+(($("#bsearch").value.trim())?", search “"+$("#bsearch").value.trim()+"”":"")+"); showing "+Math.min(bShown,E.length)+".";
  bDetail();}
function bDetail(){var d=$("#bdetail"),e=bSel,fd=$("#bfold").value;
  if(!e){d.innerHTML='<p class="note">No entry matches. Clear the search or change the filter.</p>';$("#t-browse").textContent="No entry is selected.";return;}
  var typ=e.type?(e.type==="BROAD"?"broad from the start":"localised"):(fd==="mesh"?"MeSH concept":"n/a");
  var mlab=fd==="heldout"?"Screen-fitted model with host share":"With host share and co-transfer";
  d.innerHTML='<h4 style="margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.05rem">'+esc(e.name)+" → "+esc(e.hostName)+", "+e.year+"</h4>"+
   kv([["Host-vocabulary share",f(e.share,3)+" (higher than "+pct(e.pctRank)+" of "+FOLDNAME[fd]+" entries)"],["Co-transfer",f(e.ct,2)],["Partner terms",e.partners==null?"not recorded in this file":e.partners],["Entry papers",e.entry_papers],["Origin field group",esc(e.field_group)],["Concept type",typ],["Took root",e.rooted==null?"not recorded for this fold":(e.rooted?"yes":"no")]])+
   '<div class="cmp"><div><h4>Controls-only model</h4><div class="v">'+f(e.pred_base,1)+'</div><div class="small">predicted newcomer papers</div></div><div><h4>'+mlab+'</h4><div class="v">'+f(e.pred_method,1)+'</div><div class="small">predicted newcomer papers</div></div><div><h4>Observed</h4><div class="v" style="color:var(--green)">'+e.newcomers+'</div><div class="small">newcomer papers, '+(e.year+1)+"–"+(e.year+5)+"</div></div></div>"+
   '<div class="chart" id="c-bdet" role="group" aria-label="Predicted and observed newcomer papers for the selected entry"></div>'+
   '<p class="note">'+(fd==="heldout"?"Held-out predictions apply the Screen-fitted co-primary coefficients to this fold (evaluation 2).":"Out-of-fold predictions from grouped-by-concept five-fold cross-validation (a descriptive check, not the inferential test).")+"</p>";
  var mx=Math.max(e.pred_base,e.pred_method,e.newcomers,1);var step=mx>200?100:mx>80?40:mx>40?20:mx>16?5:mx>6?2:1;
  bars($("#c-bdet"),{height:190,items:[{label:"Controls only",value:e.pred_base,color:"var(--base)",tip:"Controls-only prediction: "+f(e.pred_base,2)},{label:"With host share",short:"+ share",value:e.pred_method,color:"var(--accent)",tip:mlab+": "+f(e.pred_method,2)},{label:"Observed",value:e.newcomers,color:"var(--green)",tip:"Observed newcomer papers: "+e.newcomers}],ymax:Math.ceil(mx*1.15/step)*step,step:step,yfmt:String,valfmt:function(v){return f(v,1);},ylabel:"Newcomer papers"});
  var eb=Math.abs(e.pred_base-e.newcomers),em=Math.abs(e.pred_method-e.newcomers);
  $("#t-browse").textContent="For "+e.name+" entering "+e.hostName+" in "+e.year+", adding the host-vocabulary share moved the prediction "+(e.pred_method>e.pred_base?"up":"down")+" from "+f(e.pred_base,1)+" to "+f(e.pred_method,1)+"; "+(em<eb?"that is closer to":"that is further from")+" the "+e.newcomers+" newcomer papers observed.";}
function bReset(){bShown=60;bRender(false);}

/* ---------- margins ---------- */
var mTab="ext";
function margins(){var rows=[];var nm={SCREEN:"Screen",HELDOUT:"Held-out",MESH:"MeSH"};
  ["SCREEN","HELDOUT","MESH"].forEach(function(k){var r=MARG.folds[k][mTab];var ext=mTab==="ext";
    rows.push({label:nm[k],est:r.est,lo:r.lo,hi:r.hi,color:"var(--accent)",value:ext?f(r.est)+" pp ["+f(r.lo)+", "+f(r.hi)+"]":f(r.est,3)+" ["+f(r.lo,3)+", "+f(r.hi,3)+"]",
      tip:"<b>"+nm[k]+"</b><br>"+(ext?"Linear probability model: "+f(r.est)+" percentage points per SD, 95% CI "+f(r.lo)+" to "+f(r.hi)+"<br>Base rate of any uptake "+pct(r.base)+"<br>":"PPML on entries with uptake: IRR per SD "+f(r.est,3)+", 95% CI "+f(r.lo,3)+" to "+f(r.hi,3)+"<br>")+"N = "+comma(r.N)+", G = "+r.G});});
  var p=MARG.ivw[mTab];var ext=mTab==="ext";
  rows.push({label:"IVW pooled",bold:true,est:p.est,lo:p.lo,hi:p.hi,color:"var(--amber)",diamond:true,value:ext?f(p.est)+" pp ["+f(p.lo)+", "+f(p.hi)+"]":f(p.est,3)+" ["+f(p.lo,3)+", "+f(p.hi,3)+"]",tip:"<b>IVW pooled</b><br>"+(ext?f(p.est)+" pp per SD, 95% CI "+f(p.lo)+" to "+f(p.hi):"IRR per SD "+f(p.est,3)+", 95% CI "+f(p.lo,3)+" to "+f(p.hi,3))});
  if(ext)forest($("#c-margins"),{rows:rows,xmin:0,xmax:12,ticks:[0,2,4,6,8,10,12],nullAt:0,xlabel:"Change in P(any newcomer uptake), percentage points per SD",tickFmt:function(t){return String(t);}});
  else forest($("#c-margins"),{rows:rows,log:true,xmin:0.95,xmax:1.5,ticks:[1,1.1,1.2,1.3,1.4,1.5],nullAt:1,xlabel:"IRR per SD, given uptake started (log scale)",tickFmt:function(t){return t===1?"1":f(t,1);}});
  var s=MARG.ivw.share;
  $("#t-margins").textContent=ext?"Every fold's interval excludes zero: one SD more host vocabulary raises the chance that any newcomer uptake starts by "+f(p.est)+" percentage points pooled. The extensive margin carries "+pct(s.est)+" of the total effect (95% CI "+pct(s.lo)+" to "+pct(s.hi)+").":"Given uptake started, one SD more host vocabulary goes with "+f(p.est,3)+" times the newcomer papers pooled (95% CI "+f(p.lo,3)+" to "+f(p.hi,3)+"). This margin carries the remaining "+pct(1-s.est)+" of the effect.";}
function initMargins(){var tabs=[$("#mt-ext"),$("#mt-int")];tabs.forEach(function(b,i){b.addEventListener("click",function(){mTab=i?"int":"ext";tabs.forEach(function(x,j){x.setAttribute("aria-selected",j===i?"true":"false");x.tabIndex=j===i?0:-1;});margins();});
  b.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="ArrowRight"||e.key==="ArrowLeft"){var j=1-i;tabs[j].focus();tabs[j].click();e.preventDefault();}});});margins();}

/* ---------- cases ---------- */
var caseNames=[];CASES.forEach(function(c){if(caseNames.indexOf(c.concept)<0)caseNames.push(c.concept);});var caseCur=0;
function cap(s){return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+s.slice(1);}
function cases(){var nm=caseNames[caseCur];var rows=CASES.filter(function(c){return c.concept===nm;}).sort(function(a,b){return b.share-a.share;});
  var non=rows.filter(function(r){return !r.rooted;});var nonMean=non.length?non.reduce(function(s,r){return s+r.share;},0)/non.length:null;
  var box=$("#c-cases");var rowH=30;var o=newSvg(box,10),svg=o.svg,W=o.W;

role=\"banner\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <p class=\"kicker\">Interactive companion to the paper · 426 emerging concepts · 462,812 OpenAlex works · 191 MeSH concepts</p>\n    <h1>Host vocabulary predicts whether new scientific concepts take root across disciplinary boundaries</h1>\n    <p class=\"prose small\">The paper carries no author line. Every chart below is drawn from the run's recorded result files, embedded in this page.</p>\n    <div class=\"links\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_aMfESsKemlKH/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_aMfESsKemlKH/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_aMfESsKemlKH\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</header>\n<nav class=\"sections\" aria-label=\"Page sections\">\n  <ul>\n    <li><a href=\"#finding\">The finding</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#how\">How it works</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#explore\">Explore the evidence</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#try\">Try a threshold</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#fails\">Where it fails</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#refs\">Glossary and sources</a></li>\n  </ul>\n</nav>\n<main id=\"main\">\n\n<section class=\"sec\" id=\"finding\" aria-labelledby=\"h-finding\">\n<div class=\"wrap grid2\">\n  <div class=\"prose\">\n    <h2 id=\"h-finding\">The finding</h2>\n    <p><strong>The question.</strong> When a scientific concept first appears in a new subfield, what decides whether it takes root there?</p>\n    <p>The paper studies every <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"entry\">host-entry event</button>: the first year a concept shows up outside its origin subfield with at least five co-occurring partner terms. For each event it measures the <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"share\">host-vocabulary share</button> of those partners, and asks whether it predicts <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"uptake\">newcomer uptake</button> over the next five years.</p>\n    <p><strong>The answer.</strong> It does. On the independent MeSH biomedical population, one standard deviation more host vocabulary at entry goes with this much more newcomer uptake:</p>\n    <p class=\"bignum\" id=\"big-num\">…</p>\n    <p class=\"bignum-cap\" id=\"big-cap\">…</p>\n    <p>The competing channel, <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"ct\">co-transfer</button> of origin companions, is null everywhere. The strictest specification is inconclusive on the Held-out fold, and both main-arm folds are <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"devset\">development-set estimates</button>; the MeSH arm is the independent test.</p>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"v-forest\">\n    <p class=\"q\">Does the effect hold on every fold and specification, and does co-transfer do the same work?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <fieldset>\n        <legend>Specification</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Specification\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"fspec\" value=\"coprimary\" checked><span>Co-primary</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"fspec\" value=\"primary\"><span>Primary (strict FE)</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"fspec\" value=\"both\"><span>Both</span></label>\n        </div>\n      </fieldset>\n      <fieldset>\n        <legend>Folds shown</legend>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" name=\"ffold\" value=\"screen\" checked>Screen</label>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" name=\"ffold\" value=\"heldout\" checked>Held-out</label>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" name=\"ffold\" value=\"mesh\" checked>MeSH</label>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" name=\"ffold\" value=\"ivw\" checked>IVW pooled</label>\n      </fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Host-vocabulary share</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--green)\"></i>MeSH replication</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw d\" style=\"background:var(--amber)\"></i>IVW pooled</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>Co-transfer (competing channel)</span>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-forest\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Forest plot of incidence-rate ratios per SD\"></div>\n    <p class=\"note\">Log axis. Bars are 95% concept-clustered confidence intervals; the dashed line at 1 is no effect. Point at, tab to or tap a mark for its record.</p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-forest\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"sec\" id=\"how\" aria-labelledby=\"h-how\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-how\">How it works: one real entry, stage by stage</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose\">The stepper follows one recorded event from the Screen fold: <em>Einstein–Podolsky–Rosen steering</em> entering the OpenAlex subfield labelled Artificial Intelligence in 2011. OpenAlex files the topic \"Quantum Information and Cryptography\" under that subfield, which is broader than the colloquial meaning of AI. Use the buttons, the stage markers or the left and right arrow keys.</p>\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"stepper\" tabindex=\"-1\">\n    <p class=\"q\">What goes in at each stage, what is done to it, and what comes out?</p>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-pipe\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div>\n    <div class=\"stepnav\">\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"tbtn\" id=\"st-prev\">← Previous</button>\n      <ol class=\"stepmarks\" id=\"st-marks\" aria-label=\"Stages\"></ol>\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"tbtn\" id=\"st-next\">Next →</button>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"sr\" id=\"st-live\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <h3 id=\"st-title\" style=\"margin-top:.6em\"></h3>\n    <div class=\"stagebox\">\n      <div><h4>Goes in</h4><div id=\"st-in\"></div></div>\n      <div><h4>What is done</h4><div id=\"st-do\"></div></div>\n      <div><h4>Comes out</h4><div id=\"st-out\"></div></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-step\" style=\"margin-top:12px\"></div>\n    <p class=\"why\" id=\"st-why\"></p>\n  </div>\n  <figure>\n    <img src=\"figures/fig1_v0.jpg\" alt=\"Study design diagram in four panels: (a) data, an arXiv concept pool of 426 concepts split into a screen fold of 247 and a held-out fold of 119, plus a MeSH check population of 191 concepts, all drawn from 462,812 OpenAlex works; (b) a co-word network with three coloured communities, 25 yearly snapshots with about 27k nodes and 84k edges; (c) RQ1, a schematic matched event study comparing concepts with sustained uptake and controls around onset; (d) RQ2, a concept moving from an origin subfield into a host subfield, with host-native and origin partner terms, and the host-vocabulary share feeding a PPML regression of five-year newcomer uptake.\" loading=\"lazy\" width=\"3840\" height=\"1648\">\n    <figcaption>Figure 1 of the paper. Overview of the study design. (a) Data: an outcome-blind arXiv concept pool of 426 emerging scientific concepts, split into a screen fold (247) and a held-out fold (119), and an independent MeSH biomedical check population of 191 concepts. Both are drawn from 462,812 OpenAlex works. (b) Co-word network: yearly co-word snapshots (25 snapshots, ~27k nodes, ~84k edges) with Leiden communities; the schematic shows three colour-coded communities. (c) RQ1, emergence precursors: a matched event study compares closure measures in the pre-onset window (shaded) between concepts showing sustained uptake (blue, rising after onset) and controls (grey, flat). (d) RQ2, host-entry grafting: a concept enters a non-origin host subfield (light blue → light green region). Its partner terms are either host-native (dark green) or from the origin vocabulary (light blue). The host-vocabulary share (orange) is the exposure in a pre-registered PPML regression with concept-clustered standard errors predicting 5-year newcomer uptake. The timelines and bars in (c) and (d) are schematic and carry no data values.</figcaption>\n  </figure>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"sec\" id=\"explore\" aria-labelledby=\"h-explore\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-explore\">Explore the evidence</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose\">The regression is the test. The views here let you look under it, at the raw event records the regression was fitted to, at how the effect splits into starting uptake versus growing it, and at single concepts.</p>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"v-grad\">\n    <h3 style=\"margin-top:0\">Does uptake rise with host-vocabulary share in the raw records?</h3>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <fieldset><legend>Population</legend>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Population\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"gfold\" value=\"screen\" checked><span>Screen</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"gfold\" value=\"heldout\"><span>Held-out</span></label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"gfold\" value=\"mesh\"><span>MeSH</span></label>\n        </div></fieldset>\n      <label><span class=\"clabel\" style=\"display:block\">Outcome</span>\n        <select id=\"gmetric\">\n          <option value=\"any\">Share of entries with any newcomer paper</option>\n          <option value=\"mean\">Mean newcomer papers per entry</option>\n          <option value=\"rooted\">Share of entries that took root</option>\n        </select></label>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Quintile of host-vocabulary share</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base);height:3px\"></i>Whole-population average (baseline)</span></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-grad\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Outcome by quintile of host-vocabulary share\"></div>\n    <p class=\"note\">Computed in the page from the embedded event records: entries are ranked by host-vocabulary share and cut into five equal groups. No fixed effects or controls, so large concepts and busy hosts are mixed in; <span id=\"grad-note\"></span></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-grad\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"v-browse\" style=\"margin-top:22px\">\n    <h3 style=\"margin-top:0\">What happened to one entry, and what did the two models expect?</h3>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label><span class=\"clabel\" style=\"display:block\">Population</span>\n        <select id=\"bfold\"><option value=\"screen\">Screen (1,740 events)</option><option value=\"heldout\">Held-out (1,097 events)</option><option value=\"mesh\">MeSH (2,249 events)</option></select></label>\n      <label><span class=\"clabel\" style=\"display:block\">Show</span>\n        <select id=\"bfilter\">\n          <option value=\"all\">All entries</option>\n          <option value=\"any\">Any newcomer uptake</option>\n          <option value=\"none\">No newcomer uptake</option>\n          <option value=\"rooted\">Took root</option>\n          <option value=\"hi0\">Counter-examples: top-fifth share, no uptake</option>\n          <option value=\"lo1\">Counter-examples: bottom-fifth share, took off</option>\n        </select></label>\n      <label><span class=\"clabel\" style=\"display:block\">Sort by</span>\n        <select id=\"bsort\">\n          <option value=\"share\">Host-vocabulary share, high to low</option>\n          <option value=\"y\">Newcomer papers, high to low</option>\n          <option value=\"gain\">Largest shift from adding host share</option>\n          <option value=\"year\">Entry year, earliest first</option>\n        </select></label>\n      <label><span class=\"clabel\" style=\"display:block\">Search concept or host</span>\n        <input type=\"search\" id=\"bsearch\" placeholder=\"e.g. steering, Genetics\"></label>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"small\" id=\"bcount\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <div class=\"browser\">\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"list\" id=\"blist\"><ul id=\"bul\"></ul></div>\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"tbtn\" id=\"bmore\" style=\"margin-top:8px\">Show 60 more</button>\n      </div>\n      <div id=\"bdetail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-browse\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"v-margins\" style=\"margin-top:22px\">\n    <h3 style=\"margin-top:0\">Does host vocabulary start uptake, or grow it once started?</h3>\n    <div class=\"controls\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Margin\">\n      <button type=\"button\" role=\"tab\" class=\"tbtn\" id=\"mt-ext\" aria-selected=\"true\" aria-controls=\"c-margins\">Extensive: does any uptake start?</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" role=\"tab\" class=\"tbtn\" id=\"mt-int\" aria-selected=\"false\" aria-controls=\"c-margins\" tabindex=\"-1\">Intensive: how much, given it started?</button>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Per fold</span><span><i class=\"sw d\" style=\"background:var(--amber)\"></i>IVW pooled</span></div>\n    <div root</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:#c3c8ce\"></i>Did not take root</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--ink);height:3px\"></i>Mean share of non-rooted aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"v-adopt\" style=\"margin-top:22px\">\n    <h3 style=\"margin-top:0\">Do the authors who adopt a concept already know its partner class=\"q\">How many entries go against the gradient?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <fieldset><legend>Counter-example type</legend>\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" name=\"cx\" value=\"lo1\"><span>Low share, took off</span></label>\n      </div></fieldset>\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"tbtn\" id=\"cx-open\">Open these in the entry browser</button>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-cx\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Counter-example counts by population\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-cx\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" style=\"margin-top:22px\" id=\"v-field\">\n    <p class=\"q\">Is there a field where the effect disappears?</p>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-field\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Host-vocabulary IRR per SD by origin field group\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-field\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" style=\"margin-top:22px\" id=\"v-closure\">\n    <p class=\"q\">RQ1: is pre-emergence openness a general closure effect, or something narrower?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <fieldset><legend>Estimator</legend>\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Estimator\">\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cest\" value=\"es\" checked><span>Matched event study</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cest\" value=\"panel\"><span>Panel coefficient</span></label>\n      </div></fieldset>\n      <fieldset><legend>Fold</legend>\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Closure fold\">\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cfold\" value=\"heldout\" checked><span>Held-out</span></label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cfold\" value=\"screen\"><span>Screen</span></label>\n      </div></fieldset>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>Survives Holm correction</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>Not confirmed</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--amber)\"></i>Burt constraint (positive sign)</span></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"c-closure\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Closure estimates by measure\"></div>\n    <p class=\"note\" id=\"closure-note\"></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"t-closure\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"prose\">\n    <h3>What the paper says it does not show</h3>\n    <ul class=\"lim\">\n      <li><strong>The main-arm folds were used in development.</strong> Event counts, population sizes and gating decisions were computed on both the Screen and Held-out folds before grafting outcomes were read. The independent evidence is the MeSH replication.</li>\n      <li><strong>Population bias.</strong> The pool is dominated by physics, physical-sciences and computer-science concepts from arXiv. MeSH covers only biomedicine-to-biomedicine entries. Social sciences, humanities and engineering are untested.</li>\n      <li><strong>The strict specification is underpowered.</strong> With concept-by-year and host-by-year fixed effects, the Held-out estimate is inconclusive (IRR 0.98, 30 clusters).</li>\n      <li><strong>Single-paper entries.</strong> 87% of co-primary Screen events involve a single entry-year paper. The pooled multi-team effect is positive (IRR 1.28, 95% CI 1.11 to 1.48), but the Held-out fold alone is underpowered for this test.</li>\n      <li><strong>Graded, not a threshold.</strong> <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"rooted\">Binary establishment</button> is null on the Held-out fold (p = 0.16).</li>\n      <li><strong>Cluster-robust inference over-rejects.</strong> It rejects 10% to 11% of null shuffles in simulation (target 5%). Wild-cluster bootstrap and permutation tests agree (Held-out wild p = 0.012, permutation p = 0.026).</li>\n      <li><strong>Host-specificity is weakly tested.</strong> The Balassa-index lift measure has a within-fixed-effect correlation of 0.997 with the log of the continuous share, so it confirms the share rather than adding independent evidence.</li>\n      <li><strong>Adopter evidence is Screen-fold only</strong> and cannot separate absorptive capacity from topical proximity.</li>\n      <li><strong>Closure on the Held-out fold</strong> is a development-set estimate, and 17 of 25 unique Held-out controls come from the Screen fold. The MeSH closure result is directional under the sensitivity label but null under the primary label.</li>\n    </ul>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<footer id=\"refs\" aria-labelledby=\"h-refs\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-refs\">Links, sources and glossary</h2>\n  <div class=\"links\">\n    <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_aMfESsKemlKH/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_aMfESsKemlKH/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_aMfESsKemlKH\">Code repository</a>\n  </div>\n  <h3>Where each view's data comes from</h3>\n  <ul class=\"prov\" id=\"prov\"></ul>\n  <h3>Glossary</h3>\n  <dl class=\"gloss\" id=\"gloss\"></dl>\n  <h3>Cite</h3>\n  <p class=\"small\">Host vocabulary predicts whether new scientific concepts take root across disciplinary boundaries. () => {
  const res = [];

    const texts = [...svg.querySelectorAll('text')].filter(t => t.textContent.trim() && t.getBBox().width > 0);
    const boxes = texts.map(t => { const r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return {t: t.textContent, x0: r.left, x1: r.right, y0: r.top, y1: r.bottom}; });

}

def run(width):

        pg.click("text=Primary (strict FE)")
        print("forest primary |", pg.inner_text("#t-forest"))
        pg.locator("#v-forest").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"forest_primary_{width}.png"))
        pg.click("text=Both")
        pg.locator("#v-forest").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"forest_both_{width}.png"))
        pg.click("#v-forest label.chk:has-text('Screen')")
        print("forest both no screen |", pg.inner_text("#t-forest"))
        pg.click("#v-forest label.chk:has-text('Screen')")
        # hover a mark
        m = pg.locator("#c-forest g.mark").first
        m.hover()
        print("tip", pg.inner_text("#tip"), pg.is_visible("#tip"))
        # term click
        t = pg.locator("button.term").first
        t.click()
        pg.wait_for_timeout(100)
        print("term visible after click", pg.is_visible("#termtip"), pg.inner_text("#termtip")[:60])
        pg.locator("#finding").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"term_{width}.png"))
        pg.keyboard.press("Escape")
        print("term after esc", pg.is_visible("#termtip"))
        # stepper
        for i in range(5):
            pg.locator("#stepper").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"step{i}_{width}.png"))

            if i < 4:
                pg.click("#st-next")
        pg.focus("#st-prev")
        pg.keyboard.press("ArrowLeft")
        print("after arrow", pg.inner_text("#st-live"))

        print("after mark", pg.inner_text("#st-live"))

        for fd in ["heldout", "mesh"]:
            pg.click(f"#v-grad label:has(input[value={fd}])")

        print("grad mean |", pg.inner_text("#t-grad"))
        pg.locator("#v-grad").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"grad_{width}.png"))

        pg.select_option("#bfold", "mesh")
        pg.select_option("#bfilter", "hi0")
        print("browse |", pg.inner_text("#bcount"))
        pg.locator("#bul button.item").nth(2).click()
        print("browse sel |", pg.inner_text("#t-browse"))
        pg.select_option("#bfold", "screen")
        pg.select_option("#bfilter", "all")
        pg.fill("#bsearch", "steering")
        print("browse search |", pg.inner_text("#bcount"))
        pg.locator("#v-browse").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"browse_{width}.png"))
        pg.select_option("#bsort", "gain")
        pg.fill("#bsearch", "")
        pg.click("#bmore")
        print("browse more |", pg.inner_text("#bcount"))
        # margins
        pg.click("#mt-int")
        print("marg int |", pg.inner_text("#t-margins"))
        pg.locator("#v-margins").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"margins_{width}.png"))
        # cases
        n = pg.locator("#case-tabs button").count()
        for i in range(n):
            pg.locator("#case-tabs button").nth(i).click()
            print("case |", pg.inner_text("#t-cases"))
            pg.locator("#v-cases").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"case{i}_{width}.png"))
        # adopter
        pg.click("#v-adopt label:has(input[value=voc])")
        print("adopt voc |", pg.inner_text("#t-adopt"))
        pg.locator("#v-adopt").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"adopt_{width}.png"))
        # slider
        pg.fill("#tslider", "0.1")
        pg.dispatch_event("#tslider", "input")
        print("try 0.1 |", pg.inner_text("#t-try"))
        pg.click("#try label:has(input[value=mesh])")
        print("try mesh |", pg.inner_text("#t-try"))
        pg.locator("#try .card").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"try_{width}.png"))
        pg.locator("#c-sweep g.mark").first.hover()
        print("sweep tip", pg.inner_text("#tip"))
        # counter-examples
        pg.click("#fails label:has(input[value=lo1])")
        print("cx |", pg.inner_text("#t-cx"))
        pg.click("#cx-open")
        print("cx open |", pg.inner_text("#bcount"))
        # closure
        pg.click("#v-closure label:has(input[value=panel])")
        print("clo panel |", pg.inner_text("#t-closure"))
        pg.locator("#v-closure").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"closure_panel_{width}.png"))
        pg.click("#v-closure label:has(input[value=screen])")
        print("clo screen |", pg.inner_text("#t-closure"))
        pg.locator("#v-fields" if False else "#v-field").screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"field_{width}.png"))
        print("overlaps after ops", pg.evaluate(OVERLAP_JS))
        print("scrollWidth end", pg.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth"))
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"full_after_{width}.png"), full_page=True)
        b.close()
    print("CONSOLE", msgs)


for w in [int(a) for a in sys.argv[1:]] or [1440, 390]:
    run(w)

### [127] ASSISTANT · 2026-09-30 12:49:11 UTC

```
I've built `interactive.html` and linked it from `index.html`. I operated it in headless Chromium at 390 px and 1440 px: every control works, nothing overflows sideways, no chart labels overlap, and the console shows no errors.

- **The finding:** the headline number is **+23%** for the MeSH arm (IRR 1.23, 95% CI 1.12 to 1.36), shown next to a chart of the effect on every fold. You can switch between the co-primary and strict specifications and turn folds on or off. The co-transfer estimate, the competing explanation, is always drawn beside each result. Every value in this chart matches Table 2 of the paper exactly, including the co-transfer p-values.
- **How it works:** a five-stage walkthrough of one real recorded entry, Einstein–Podolsky–Rosen steering entering the subfield OpenAlex labels Artificial Intelligence in 2011 (host-vocabulary share 0.142, 37 newcomer papers). It moves by buttons, stage markers or arrow keys.
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - **Uptake by share:** uptake by fifth of host-vocabulary share, computed live from the event records.
  - **Entry browser:** covers 1,740 Screen, 1,097 Held-out and 2,249 MeSH entries, with filter, sort and search. The selected entry shows the model's prediction without host share, the prediction with it, and what was observed.
  - **Two margins:** whether uptake starts at all, and how much given that it started.
  - **Four case concepts.**
  - **Adopter results.**
- **Try it:** a slider sets a cut-off on host-vocabulary share and recomputes uptake above and below it. The page says plainly that this is a raw split without the regression's fixed effects.
- **Where it fails:** counts of entries that go against the pattern, with a button that opens them in the browser. Also the results by origin field, the RQ1 closure results, and the paper's own limitations.
- **Footer:** all links, the source file behind each chart, and a 19-term glossary. Each term also has a definition that opens on hover, focus or tap.

Things you might trip over:
- **Author line:** `paper.tex` has an empty author field, so the header says the paper carries no author line rather than naming anyone.
- **Burt constraint rounding:** the source file stores 0.1046, which rounds to 0.10, but the paper prints 0.11. The closure chart rounds to three decimals and then two, which reproduces all of that chart's paper values. I note this under the chart.
- **Screen entry count:** the browser holds all 1,740 recorded Screen entries, while the Screen regression uses 1,544 of them. The page states both numbers.
- **Figures:** I used only Figure 1, the study-design diagram. The paper's other figures are data plots, which the page draws itself from the data.
